headline: Clean: on the fixed date, the only active points or cash sign-up bonus on a personal card open to this customer is the EcoCard's.
solution_check: Personal-card promos on 2025-11-14: EcoCard bonus points window 2025-08-01 to 2025-12-15 (active; $2,000 points for $5,000 in month 1); Silver $500 statement credit window 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30 (expired); Bronze and Silver promos are 0% APR, not points or cash; Platinum's first-year fee waiver ended 2024-12-31; Diamond Elite's $5,000-credit promo is invitation-only. With business cards excluded, EcoCard is the only option, so the fee tie-break is not needed. Replay of EcoCard/Jordan Mitchell/62000/false matches the gold.
